findings: A05 and A06 were taken 19 seconds apart by same author; likely one shooting session and not independent samples; this is a hypothesis until image comparison.
Names of businesses such as Friends Restaurant and Friends & Neighbours Cafe must not be parsed as people-in-photo.
A01 is a 2015 author-owned Flickr photograph but EXIF reports Photoshop 7.0; original camera file and uploaded edit should be distinguished.
A08 shows that self-uploaded 'own work' does not imply unstaged or smartphone-shot.
EXIF values can be misleading: A01 f/1 and 0mm focal length may reflect adapted manual lens or missing lens data, not a literal zero-mm lens.
counting_rule: These are provenance audits only; do not increase visual original count.
